head: 190845ad
headSubject: feat(path-a): P4.1 public/private boundaries on packs
summary: Implemented and committed P4.1 (Phase 4) of NPDEV_PATH_A_REALIGNMENT_PLAN.md: public/private boundaries on packs. Added private[]/extensionPoints[] to pack.schema.json (both mirrors); enforced at ModelSourceResolver's existing QualifiedReferenceValidator choke point (the same mechanism D3 context-import gating uses) -- a reference from outside a pack to one of its own declared-private members refuses composition, naming the pack and the member; a pack's own members reference each other freely; a private concept flagged as an extensionPoint may still be specialized despite not being otherwise referenceable. Had to fix two real gaps found along the way: (1) rewriteConceptName previously validated only an already-qualified authored reference, never a bare name's RESOLVED qualified form -- silently missing the 'normal path' bare pack reference entirely; (2) resolvePackRoot didn't pass through the new private/extensionPoints keys at all (the established REG-108 schema-validates-then-vanishes shape), and concepts.specializes/extends was never wired into rewriteKnownMemberReferenceFields to begin with. Also fixed an unrelated pre-existing regression in ModelChangeClassifierTest (found while regression-testing): the P3.5 specialization-medical-invoice corpus sample broke its raw-compile corpus check because hasInlineConcepts() didn't know a non-empty concepts[] can still reference an unresolved pack-qualified base. Commit 190845ad.
nextStep: Start P4.2 of NPDEV_PATH_A_REALIGNMENT_PLAN.md: cross-application reuse proof. doneWhen (helpers/tasks.json): 'Two corpus apps consume the same versioned pack, both generate and boot, and a check fails if the pack is forked rather than shared.' Marked checkable:false (MANUAL) in tasks.json, dependsOn P4.1 (now done). Needs: pick or create two corpus apps (AppGen/apps or NPDevSamples) that import the SAME versioned pack (npdev.lock pinning the same digest/version for both), verify both generate+build+boot, then add a checker that fails if the two apps' resolved pack content has DIFFERENT digests for the same declared pack id/version (i.e. one was forked/hand-copied instead of genuinely shared) -- likely belongs alongside check-pack-coverage.py or as a new scripts/quality/check-*.py wired into run-ai-knowledge-gate.ps1 per the script-inventory rules. After P4.2: P4.3 (a second/third first-party pack, contracts only, also MANUAL).
verified: NPDevContract:dsl:test full suite green (includes new PackVisibilityTest: 7/7 passing, plus SpecializationParentVersionDriftTest re-verified with no regressions from the rewriteConceptName/rewriteKnownMemberReferenceFields changes). NPDevGenerator:generator:test full suite green (510 tests, including the ModelChangeClassifierTest fix). check-schema-mirror-consistency.py, check-twin-pair-consistency.py, check-dsl-coverage.py, check-doc-inventory.py all green after the schema/resolver changes. Path A plan's own helpers/check_task.py --task P4.1 reports PASS (pack visibility keys: ['extensionPoints', 'private']).
